model_interpretation.claim: A 32x32 shared tile indexed as tile[row][col ^ row] provides a meaningful alternative to the padded 32x33 scalar layout: it preserves coalesced global loads/stores while avoiding padding, and may avoid shared-memory bank conflicts on a 32-bank organization.
